name: gba-bkk-icesat2-provisional
source: GlobalBuildingAtlas LoD1 vs ICESat-2 ATL03 roof-minus-ground, 3,817 Bangkok buildings, Nov 2018 - Apr 2026 (published bin means, Thai post, 2026)
method: classical calibration: invert E[GBA | true] so the corrected city keeps the real spread of heights (right for a skyline). Per-building estimates for H/W or SVF want inverse regression E[true | GBA] instead, which needs the matched pairs, not bin means.
assumption: The published bins are keyed on ICESat-2 height; bin midpoints stand in for the unpublished true means except the top bin (126 m measured). Refit from the matched pairs before treating any single corrected height as a measurement.
